title: On Basic Properties of Bitopological Algebroids
content: We introduce a basic framework for algebroid structures over a set equipped with two topologies. The principal algebraic object is a pair of Lie algebroids over a common smooth manifold, together with two specified topologies on the underlying set. We investigate the anchor maps, isotropy Lie algebras, morphisms, products, and cohomology associated with such pairs. We distinguish the topological data from the smooth structure required to define vector bundles and differential operators. This distinction is essential: two topologies alone do not determine two algebroid structures. We establish elementary results concerning strongly compatible pairs and give examples arising from tangent bundles, Lie algebra actions, and Poisson manifolds. Finally, we formulate several problems concerning topology-sensitive sections, compatible algebroid structures, and integration.
